summary: Verification-only phase (no production implementation, no contract edits, no live host mutation). Independently, adversarially re-verified whether HPAC-PAWA-HELPER-001 v3.0 Model E (the hybrid of Model B helper-only mutation facades and Model C store-local scoped authority families that the predecessor repair phase selected after Model D's independent-verification failure) genuinely closes the two confirmed Model D defects -- mint-side same-interpreter seal exclusion, and store-side mint-provenance-blind recognition -- or merely renamed the same broad-authority problem. VERDICT: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED at the contract level. Mint exclusion now rests on a genuine OS-process boundary (HPAC-PAWA-HELPER-REQ-145: the mint primitive and its seal are defined only in a module never imported by any agent-reachable code path), a different class of guarantee than Model D's checkable-but-forgeable same-interpreter attribute. Store recognition now rests on type-level, non-isinstance, sealed-family distinction (REQ-148/151, PAWAH-INV-20), explicitly two-directional (helper-scoped and legacy authority cannot satisfy each other's recognition predicates). All three required matrices (store-recognition, certification 5x5 role matrix, admin 7x7 subtype matrix) independently reconstructed from raw contract table text (not copied from the predecessor) and confirmed diagonal-PERMIT/off-diagonal-DENY. Both predecessor-IV threat-matrix gaps (rows 31/32 of the 40-row merged threat matrix) independently confirmed real in the predecessor record and confirmed closed in v3.0. REQ-033's own text confirmed byte-unchanged; the additive REQ-171 clarification confirmed compatible and load-bearing for the mint-exclusion fix. HPAC-PAWA-001 v2.0 and HPAC-PPA-001 v2.0 confirmed byte-identical and correctly left unevolved -- Model E changes only where the mint primitive is defined and what type it produces, not either companion contract's own authority-decision or evidence-write ownership. No production implementation of Model E exists yet in src/pcae/** (confirmed by absence) -- expected and correct for a contract-only verification phase; several properties are therefore VERIFIED AT THE CONTRACT LEVEL / untestable at runtime until an implementation phase exists, a legitimate limitation, not a finding against the contract. No blocking contract-text defect was found. Predecessor completion-evidence reconciliation: EVIDENCE-MINOR-MISMATCH -- commit sequence, hashes, and push state all independently confirmed accurate; one non-material stale duplicate metadata field (validation_results.pcae_push_check) found and corrected this phase. Two non-blocking items carried forward as explicit obligations for the next phase: REQ-171's independent-verifiability obligation (import-graph structural test, untestable until the module exists) and the pre-existing disclosed HPACStoreAuthority._new_capability-has-no-own-seal observation (unworsened by Model E). Fresh IV tests: 40 new, independently authored, all passed. Combined with predecessor's 48+24 suites: 112/112 passed. Helper-boundary regression: 96 passed/1 skipped/0 failed, matching predecessor baseline exactly. Production source: NONE changed. Contract trio: byte-identical before and after. N-16-5 remains NOT CLOSED. N-16-6/N-16-7 untouched. Runtime unchanged: Observed / observe / unavailable. Recommended successor: N16-5-F-5-TB-HELPER-WRITER-AUTHORITY-IMPL (or repository-conformant equivalent), NOT begun.
